name: Meridian Rising: The HelixCorp Century
description: Commissioned directly by HelixCorp to commemorate the corponation's centennial, this 3-hour holographic spectacle presents a heroic revisionist history of M88's construction, framing HelixCorp's territorial acquisitions as benevolent urban salvation. Mandatory screening was required for all HelixCorp employees at onboarding, and the film was distributed free to Tier 2 zones within HelixCorp territory. The production budget exceeded Φ 800 million, making it the most expensive corporate-funded film in M88 history at the time of release.
cultural_impact: Meridian Rising became the definitive example of 'centennial cinema' as a corporate PR format, and its visual language — golden-hour holographics, soaring choral scores — is now immediately recognized as propaganda shorthand.
story_hooks: An original cut of the film exists with a segment depicting the Shelf Clearances; a HelixCorp archivist is willing to trade it for protection.
The film's lead holographic compositor left HelixCorp after release and claims she was forced to falsify historical footage — she wants help going public.
A community in the Shelf has been staging satirical re-enactments of the film's most egregious scenes; HelixCorp security has begun taking notice.
